description:
Wire autocomplete suggestions into a visual dropdown below/above the input cursor.

Implement:
- Trigger autocomplete on / prefix or configurable triggers
- Render suggestion list as overlay near cursor position
- Up/Down to navigate, Tab/Enter to accept, Escape to dismiss
- Fuzzy filtering as user types
- Show description next to label
- Max visible items with scroll indicator

Upstream: packages/tui/src/components/input.ts (autocomplete integration), select-list.ts
Depends on: autocomplete provider API, overlay system (already built), select_list component
title: Autocomplete dropdown UI in Input component
